review_candidates.title: IT System Specialist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: What You’ll Do Based in our Alexandria office, you'll manage and administer global Microsoft 365 tenant(s) (E3/E5) across multiple regions. Architect and maintain secure configurations across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams. Administer Microsoft Intune and Windows 365 environments, including device compliance policies, security baselines, and Autopilot provisioning. Maintain an accurate and up-to-date IT asset inventory, including hardware and software tracking.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: You’ll gain hands-on AI experience and develop a future-proof skillset while contributing to a fast-moving, high-impact product. 1+ year hands-on experience managing Microsoft E5 security capabilities. Strong expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, and identity governance. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender suite and security incident response. Ability to document processes clearly and support audit requirements.
